meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (state estimates from each state's Directorate of Economics and Statistics)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year is the state's latest estimate; states revise at different times and the API carries no revision label. The newest year is usually an advance or quick estimate.
meta.coverage: Net state value added by state, industry and sub-industry, ₹ crore at constant 2011-12 prices
meta.note: MoSPI NAS regional account, indicator 30, served in ₹ lakh and converted to ₹ crore (two decimals). Series keys are <state>__<industry>[__<sub-industry>]. J&K split at 2019-20. MoSPI labels the NSVA total row "Total Gross State Value Added"; it is the NSVA total. Excluded as a server defect: Karnataka, whose indicator 30 rows repeat the state's GSVA at current prices (current equals constant in every year).
